reason: Lint: useDialogFocus has no suppression left. Its open effect listed only [open, ref] so an owner's inline callbacks never re-run it (a re-run took focus out of a dialog opened over the phone's Help sheet); under that suppression it hid a react/refs warning (initialFocus written to a ref during render) and a react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning (kind and returnFocusTo read but not listed). kind, initialFocus and returnFocusTo are now kept in refs written after each commit; the open effect reads all three when the dialog opens and keeps them until it closes, so focus goes back through the returnFocusTo the dialog opened with, as before. Nine new dialog-first-focus tests pin focus on open and back on Escape for four desktop dialogs and four phone sheets (three of them nested; they failed with the recorded re-run brought back) and the return target kept when the owner re-renders with another returnFocusTo while the dialog is open (a small harness of the hook, e2e/support/dialogFocusHarness.tsx; reading the newest returnFocusTo failed it). tsconfig.e2e.json maps /e2e/* as it maps /src/*, for that import. Hidden warnings under suppressions 16 -> 14, none of them refs. With no refs warning left in view or hidden, react/refs moves up to an error (its warn override goes from .oxlintrc.json); a new lint-policy test plants a ref written during render and expects one refs error and exit code 1 (it failed before the move, with a warning). The warning cap is unchanged at 50. #625 item 5.
